description: Generate a BATCH of premium creatives of one asset type (SAC), or bulk-order N assets in one request (bulk* actions: pricing, order, status, assets, cancel — credits charged upfront, failed items auto-refund) — image: 6 image ads (3 with text + 3 clean) · video: 4 video ads · ugc_video: 3 UGC presenter videos · google_ads: 12 ad variations · ugc_action: 3 UGC in-action videos. create → (customize) → confirm. Interactive UGC/in-action uses confirm sub-payloads. pricing / eligibility quote the credit cost first. Actions: pricing, eligibility, create, confirm, cancel, status, assets, regenerateAsset, downloadAll, bulkPricing, bulkOrder, bulkStatus, bulkAssets, bulkCancel. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.
